# Combined experiment matrix (generated by build_comparison.py)

Matcher setting = ESCO + job-filtered queries pooled (dev set). exp01 = original evaluation re-scored on the reviewed labels (n = 40); exp02/exp03 = reviewed dev set (n = 40). Recall@5 = Hit@5 / n (one relevant item counted per query). Precision@5 is not recoverable from the stored data. Memory = model RSS growth (indicative). Configurations are comparable within an experiment; across experiments the code paths differ slightly (exp01 used Qdrant + the production Retriever, exp02/03 exact numpy search).
